name: Gsc Pap
description:
Ask Claude about your Google Search Console top queries, decaying pages, ranking trends, content cannibalization, quick wins.

Plug-and-play hosted MCP bridge: sign in with Google, copy a token, paste it. No GCP project, no Python, no JSON config files to manage.

18 read-only tools covering Search Analytics, URL Inspection, Sitemaps, and a built-in archive for trending data beyond Google's 16-month window.

Per-site authorization layer means you decide which properties Claude can see, even though OAuth grants account-wide access. All tool calls audited at app.gscpap.com

Built for SEO consultants, in-house marketers, and developers who want to delegate analysis to AI without exposing their Google credentials or wrangling 1000-line CSV exports.
longDescription:
Ships **1 MCP server**, `gsc-pap`.

Installs with `claude plugin install gsc-pap@claude-community` from `aliarifsoydas/gsc-pap-claude-plugin`.

Ask Claude about your Google Search Console data — top queries, decaying pages, ranking trends, quick wins, content cannibalization. Plug & play hosted MCP, no GCP project, no Python, no JSON files to manage.
